newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: GOLF-CONSISTENT HUGHES WINS PLAYERS' TITLE.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-CONSISTENT HUGHES WINS PLAYERS' TITLE.

text.p: Australia's Bradley Hughes fired a final round of two-under-par 69 on Sunday to win the US$395,000 Players' Championship by 12 strokes.
Hughes was the only player to shoot four consecutive sub-par rounds and set up his first tournament win in three years with a decisive five-under 66 in Saturday's third round.
He finished with a 14-under aggregate of 270 after leading by eight shots overnight.
Fellow Australians Peter Lonard and Robert Stephens tied for second on 282, Lonard closing with a 70 and Stephens with a 73.
Americans Peter Teravainen and J.J West and Australia's Scott Laycock shared fourth place on 284.
